title: Decision Record Schema
description: Strategic or architectural decision record (Phase 1+, docs/decisions/ADR-*.md). Immutable record of what was decided, why, and by what authority.

decision.description: Clear statement of what was decided and why (2–3 sentences)

context.description: Background: master plan section, threat model concern, blocked issue, or user request

rationale.description: Why this option was chosen; evidence cited

consequences.description: What changes as a result; implementation phase; risks accepted

threat_model_category.description: If applicable, threat category from threat-model.md

phase.description: Which phase implements or depends on this decision

author.description: Who made the decision (e.g., 'user input', 'Phase 7 synthesis', 'autonomous Phase X')

examples.title: Single Model (qwen2.5-coder:32b) for All Roles
examples.decision: Use one Ollama model (qwen2.5-coder:32b, Q4 quantization) for all factory roles (router, analyst, builder, reviewer) instead of multi-model setup to simplify configuration and reduce memory churn.
examples.context: Master plan §1 specifies 'Do not assume the largest model is operationally best'. Plan §8 recommends benchmark candidates: 7b, 14b, 32b, 30b variants. User hardware: 32 GB RAM, 0 dedicated VRAM, sequential inference. Qwen2.5-coder:32b estimated ~18–20 GB RAM (Q4).

options_considered.tradeoffs: Better specialized performance, complex switching, more memory churn
Simpler config, all roles use same context, ~18–20 GB RAM, less specialized
Faster inference, lower capability, weaker for reviewer

examples.rationale: Single model avoids complexity of model-switching logic (Phase 6). 32b is capable enough for all roles while fitting in RAM with margin. Simpler benchmarking story. User expressed preference for simplicity.
examples.consequences: Phase 6 Model Gateway: all roles alias to qwen2.5-coder:32b. Phase 3: pyproject.toml lists one model. Phase 8: OPA policy treats all roles with same constraints. If 32b is too slow, fallback to 14b documented in Phase 6.

evidence.linked_issue: User input during Phase 1 prerequisite questions

examples.author: User decision (2026-10-03)
